concerns.text: Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires every external citation to be verified. The ATP‑III criteria are referenced by name only with no verified source URL, violating the constitution.
Phase 1 lists FR‑009 (odds‑ratio reporting) as addressed, but FR‑009 pertains to logistic regression results (Phase 5). This FR mapping is inaccurate.
The contract `classification.schema.yaml` is defined but never exercised by any plan step; no artifact is generated that conforms to this schema, leaving the contract unused.
The data‑model defines a `dataset.schema.yaml` for raw and processed GTEx data, yet the plan does not explicitly reference or generate an artifact that validates against this schema.
